Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelObserver, VirtualServer
public final class GameController extends Object implements VirtualServer, ModelObserver
MVC controller that bridges the network layer and the model. Manages the lobby lifecycle, the match lifecycle and the persistence of leaderboard data. Implements VirtualServer to expose the actions the clients can invoke and ModelObserver to forward model notifications to every interested VirtualView.
